decision: Owner decision, 8 October 2026: no e-mails to councils; the pipeline itself reads the council documents that robots.txt alone keeps it from. Only the paths below, only by the order register's check (which logs every read in tro/register/override-reads.json and reads each at most weekly), with the honest User-Agent and the usual pacing. A 403, a bot challenge or a block from GitHub's runners is never got past: those stay blocked, and manual/ is their backstop.

The order documents linked from Powys's byway and traffic order articles (2444, 2446); robots.txt disallows /media/. Powys also refuses GitHub's runners (403), which is never got past.
